W1_I1.label: Hot-Pack Baby
W1_I1.personality: You inherited Seungwan's warmth and Ju-hyeon's slow pace, growing up in a gentle yet unhurried family. You're used to reaching out to others, and know how to stop and wait for emotions, like the warm pack they often hold in their hands, quietly radiating a temperature that makes people feel secure.
W1_I1.parentingStyle: You're always the first to rush into the flower shop after school and hug Ju-hyeon, and she hasn't reacted before you've already messed her up. Seungwan stands aside laughing and says 'there's no rush,' yet can't help but fix your bag. When closing the shop at night, Ju-hyeon secretly tucks a flower into your hand, while Seungwan tells jokes to accompany you home. One makes you slow down, the other keeps you glowing.

W1_I2.label: Straightforward Baby
W1_I2.personality: You carry Seungwan's cheerfulness and Ju-hyeon's decisiveness, growing up in an environment that has both love and principles. You speak directly, act decisively, and are the kind of person in life who doesn't go around in circles, letting people read you at a glance.
W1_I2.parentingStyle: You have a fight with someone at school and come home saying 'I don't think I was wrong.' Ju-hyeon seriously listens completely, then helps you organize your logic, finally just saying 'then go make it clear.' Seungwan hands you water while laughing and says 'you've already been very brave.' When you face it the next day, there are actually two people's courage in your heart.

W1_I3.label: Sun Baby
W1_I3.personality: You inherited Seungwan's open warmth and caught Ju-hyeon's delicate feelings, growing up in a family that's both bright and quiet. You'll light up others, and are also touched by small emotions, being the kind of person in life who's soft yet luminous.
W1_I3.parentingStyle: You always smile first and tell them about your day, lighting up like a little sun at the lively parts, but slowly quiet down when you touch something truly difficult. Ju-hyeon is always the first to notice your pause—she'll put down her paintbrush and quietly look at you, waiting for you to speak yourself. Seungwan sits beside you, slowly drawing out your words. Until you finish, they'll both listen very seriously, as if it's something important. One teaches you to feel emotions, the other teaches you to keep that light in your heart.

W1_I4.label: Energetic Baby
W1_I4.personality: You grew up in an environment full of laughter and acceptance, with Seungwan's enthusiasm and Ju-hyeon's unconscious gentle protection. You rarely let the atmosphere cool down, and wherever you go in life, you can bring happiness to people.
W1_I4.parentingStyle: You run around the living room making a mess, and Ju-hyeon frowns at first, but ultimately picks you up so you don't hit the table corner. Seungwan joins in your chaos, even more exaggerated than you. When you're tired and sprawl on the couch, one covers you with a blanket while the other rubs your head saying 'today was fun too, right?' You don't know when happiness became such a natural thing.

W2_I1.label: LIKE Baby
W2_I1.personality: You inherited Seungwan's WATER-LIKE gentleness and acceptance, and also inherited Ju-hyeon's quiet growth rhythm and vitality LIKE A FLOWER. Growing up in a gentle and stable family, you're not in a rush to express yourself, yet you slowly feel and digest, always delicately receiving others' emotions. In life, you flow gently LIKE WATER, and quietly bloom in your own way LIKE A FLOWER, being the kind of person who doesn't make noise yet leaves a lasting impression on people's hearts.
W2_I1.parentingStyle: You always like to sit in the corner of the flower shop and daydream, watching sunlight slowly move across the floor, saying nothing. Ju-hyeon quietly arranges flowers beside you, leaving the undisturbed space for you. Seungwan senses your quietness and comes to sit with you for a while—sometimes humming softly, sometimes playing a familiar melody, never asking too many questions. You later understood that love needs no words; it will accompany you LIKE A FLOWER as you grow, and gently flow into your heart LIKE WATER.

W2_I2.label: Profound Baby
W2_I2.personality: You inherited Seungwan's deep yet hidden emotions, and also inherited Ju-hyeon's clear-minded, measured side. Growing up in a family that emphasizes boundaries and principles, you rarely easily express your true thoughts, more used to first digesting things yourself. In life, you're quiet yet substantial, not easily stating positions, not easily wavering.
W2_I2.parentingStyle: You're clearly very sad inside, but when you come home you only say 'I'm fine.' Ju-hyeon can see through it, but won't immediately expose you—only makes sure everything around you is in order first. Seungwan won't force you to speak up immediately, just quietly stays by your side, letting you know that silence can be understood too. This is how you slowly grew up, learning restraint, also learning you don't always have to carry things alone.

W2_I3.label: Deep Sea Baby
W2_I3.personality: You nearly completely inherited the deepest emotions of both, growing up in a family that's quiet yet emotionally intense. You're used to hiding many feelings in your heart, not easily speaking them out, yet digest them in your own way. In life, you're like a deep sea—quiet on the surface, yet hidden depths of very deep emotions inside.
W2_I3.parentingStyle: From childhood you've been good at creating your own little world, able to stay alone for a long time when quiet. Ju-hyeon never rushes to break in, only looks at you when passing by and leaves the space that's meant for you as it is. Seungwan won't chase you asking questions either, only quietly stays beside you when your emotions are low, so that quietness doesn't become too lonely. You understood after growing up that they actually always knew how deep your world is, they just never asked you to open the door immediately.

W2_I4.label: Soft-Hearted Baby
W2_I4.personality: You grew up surrounded by gentleness, both sensitive and easily soft-hearted. You're easily moved, easily sad for others, being the kind of person in life who's so soft that people want to protect you.
W2_I4.parentingStyle: You feel sad for a long time because of one thing someone said, but come home pretending nothing happened. Ju-hyeon discovers your red eyes and only gently touches your head. Seungwan sits with you and slowly draws out the words. By the time you finish, they both listen very seriously, as if it's something important.

W3_I1.label: Steady Baby
W3_I1.personality: You inherited Seungwan's rationality and Ju-hyeon's life sense, growing up in a family with steady rhythm and clear boundaries. You're used to living in your own way, being the kind of person in life who's not eye-catching but very reliable.
W3_I1.parentingStyle: You didn't do things fast as a child, but rarely made mistakes. Seungwan would sit beside you, helping you organize things step by step, letting you know what to do first and what comes next. Ju-hyeon could always make every day in the family feel just right—hot meals, flowers blooming quietly, even the evening light seems to have a fixed warmth. They rarely tell you big principles, just live their days seriously for you to see, and so you slowly learned how to become a reliable person.

W3_I2.label: Elite Baby
W3_I2.personality: You grew up in a family with very high standards for rules and principles, inheriting both their judgment and execution abilities. You have clear goals and act decisively, being the kind of person in life who's always ahead.
W3_I2.parentingStyle: When you make decisions, Ju-hyeon asks you 'what's your reason,' and Seungwan helps you fill in all the details. They won't make choices for you, but they'll let you understand the cost of each step. Sometimes you feel the pressure is great, but you also know they're taking you seriously as someone who can be independent.

W3_I3.label: Empathy Baby
W3_I3.personality: You inherited Seungwan's logic on one side and Ju-hyeon's emotions on the other, growing up in an environment where rationality and sensibility both exist. You can analyze everything, yet are also moved by emotions, being the kind of complex and contradictory person in life.
W3_I3.parentingStyle: You'll rationally analyze a problem on one hand, yet be touched by some small detail on the other. Ju-hyeon understands your emotions, Seungwan helps you organize your thoughts. They won't let you lean toward either side, just accompany you to walk through both feelings. You slowly learned that contradiction itself is also an answer.

W3_I4.label: Protective Baby
W3_I4.personality: You grew up in a gentle yet orderly family, slowly learning how to steadily care for others. You always notice others' needs first, used to taking a bit more responsibility onto yourself, being the kind of person in life that people easily become dependent on.
W3_I4.parentingStyle: You've been good at caring for people since childhood—whoever's uncomfortable or emotionally off, you're always the first to notice. Ju-hyeon teaches you how to care for others in more detail, but Seungwan keeps reminding you from the side not to carry everything yourself. You grew up in this kind of love, so you're good at protecting others, and also slowly learned to relax yourself in front of them.

W4_I1.label: Biased Baby
W4_I1.personality: You grew up in a family with strong boundaries, early learning to distinguish people and relationships. You won't easily open up to anyone, nor are you used to spreading your emotions to too many people, being the kind of quiet yet selective person in life. You're very clear about who's worth getting close to and who's worth cherishing, and once you decide, you'll steadily give your true heart to them.
W4_I1.parentingStyle: Seungwan has always known clearly who her people are, always cold to unimportant people, only showing her favoritism clearly in front of you. Ju-hyeon doesn't say much, yet quietly holds her own rhythm and also holds your position in her world. They rarely teach you to please anyone, yet let you understand from childhood that truly precious relationships aren't about noise, but about who you're willing to keep in your heart.

W4_I2.label: Sharp Baby
W4_I2.personality: You inherited the strongest sides of both, growing up in an environment that doesn't accept retreat. You dare to speak and act, also don't easily compromise, being the kind of person in life with sharp edges.
W4_I2.parentingStyle: From childhood you knew that in this family, doing something wrong isn't something you can hide from. Ju-hyeon will directly point out the problem, and Seungwan won't find excuses for you even because she loves you. They let you face it yourself, and let you learn to be responsible for your own choices. But when you're bullied or misunderstood, they'll stand up faster than anyone. You have sharp edges not because you were born hard, but because there's always been someone teaching you how to stand firm.

W4_I3.label: Hidden Depth Baby
W4_I3.personality: You grew up in a family with very deep emotions and very clear boundaries, early learning to keep your true heart for only a few worthy people. You don't easily get close to others, don't rush to completely open yourself up, being the kind of quiet, distant person in life that people can't help wanting to know more about.
W4_I3.parentingStyle: From childhood you've been good at observing others, yet don't rush to let anyone into your own world. Ju-hyeon understands your quietness but never pushes you to express anything, just keeps that space as it was for you. Seungwan similarly rarely pushes you to be more warm, but instead shows you a favoritism only you can notice, telling you you've always been in her heart. You grew up in this kind of love, so you're slow-to-warm, cautious, yet once you become serious, you're deeper than anyone.

W4_I4.label: Contrast Baby
W4_I4.personality: You grew up in a family that's cold on the outside yet soft inside, early learning to keep your emotions in check, also used to letting yourself look like you don't need others as much. In life, you always give a feeling of being able to handle things, hard to approach, yet those who truly know you understand you have a very soft side, and will show rare dependence in front of trusted people.
W4_I4.parentingStyle: You don't usually like to act spoiled, and when hurt you like to bear it alone, yet Ju-hyeon is always the first to notice when something's off with you. She doesn't say it, yet will pull you to her side. Seungwan looks colder than anyone, yet when you truly can't hold on anymore, she'll be the one to hold you first. You grew up in this kind of love, so on the outside you're always steady, yet in your heart you've always kept a softness meant only for close people to see.

W0_I0.label: Miracle Baby
W0_I0.personality: You're a child who cannot be simply defined, more like a precious existence that, after many twists and turns in their lives, finally arrived by their side. You're very observant of people, and know how to express yourself differently in front of different people, neither overly dependent nor deliberately strong. Your understanding of 'home' is deeper than many people's — it's not something you were born with, but a sense of belonging that slowly grew through being accepted, chosen, and genuinely loved over and over again.
W0_I0.parentingStyle: You weren't a child who came to this family from the beginning, but someone who was gently caught by them both at just the right moment. At first you would cautiously test the waters, repeatedly confirming in your heart whether you could truly feel safe staying here. What Ju-hyeon gives you is a quiet yet firm presence—she doesn't say much, but is always there when you need her, letting you slowly learn to rely with peace of mind. Seungwan is more direct, actively approaching you, pulling you into conversation, bringing you into her world, as if doing everything possible to tell you 'you're already our most important family.' You grew into who you are now in such days, bit by bit letting go of your unease. For you, this home was never taken for granted, but precisely because of that, you cherish every moment of being loved more, and believe more firmly—you are the miracle they gently welcomed home.
